decisions.reason: The cited passage accurately establishes a repeatable Meridian Study procedure: a scheduled bell, named board, mandatory silence, one-line contributions, and prescribed problem posting. The frozen source establishes Meridian Study and its bell, but not this multi-part board protocol. Because the packet expressly forbids new rules and permits background texture only when it creates no continuity obligation, the invention-budget breach and claimed continuity consequence follow. The required report could not be written to the declared path because the workspace is read-only.
